one_line: Nvidia reshapes leadership and China policy while OpenAI and Microsoft ship new models and AI funding surges.

themes.title: Nvidia leadership and China policy shift
themes.text: Nvidia reported Q3 revenue of $115.8B and a $130B Q4 forecast under interim CEO Colette Kress, who also ended H200 chip sales to China. The board said it will not reinstate Jensen Huang, who will testify before US House committees on Dec 1, and created a new National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee.

stories.headline: Nvidia reports Q3 revenue of $115.8B and forecasts Q4 revenue of $130B
Nvidia board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
Nvidia ends H200 chip sales in China under acting CEO Colette Kress
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to testify before US House committees on Dec 1
Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore unit revenue in 2025 as it hit $104B
Nvidia's startup stakes reach $65.5B as interim CEO signals caution

themes.title: OpenAI and Microsoft ship new models
themes.text: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower pricing and benchmark gains, while Microsoft unveiled six models including MAI Code 2 and Flash on GitHub Copilot, claiming high performance at lower cost.

stories.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol for ChatGPT Work and Codex
OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models with benchmark gains
Microsoft unveils six AI models including MAI Code 2 and Flash

themes.title: AI funding rounds and IPO plans
themes.text: Isomorphic Labs raised a $5B Series C for AI drug design, Genesis AI raised $500M at a $3.5B valuation for robotics, Numa raised $45M for dealership AI, and Perplexity said it may IPO as early as Q1 2027 after crossing $1B in annual recurring revenue.

Genesis AI raises $500 million Series A at $3.5 billion valuation
Numa raises $45M Series C to expand AI operating system for car dealerships
Perplexity CEO says company may launch IPO as early as Q1 2027

themes.title: Export controls and sovereign AI push
themes.text: The US Commerce Department tightened AI chip export rules targeting Southeast Asian data centres, while Sarvam AI launched Token Factory to serve open-weight models on Indian servers, HCLTech and Cohere partnered on sovereign AI, and OpenAI named Pragya Misra to lead business development in India and South Asia.
